candidates.explanation: For FileDriver.LOCAL the transform prefixes the file path with appConfig().frontendDomain (FRONTEND_DOMAIN) instead of backendDomain (BACKEND_DOMAIN). Local files are served by the backend, so photo URLs in user responses (e.g. /auth/me) point at the frontend host and fail to load.

fix.description: Use backendDomain instead of frontendDomain for the local driver.
